about_the_game:
Ever wanted to live out the American dream of working an abysmal 9–5 with rude management and zero upward mobility?
No?
Well too bad — I made a game about it anyway.

Play as a down-on-your-luck college student who just scored a gig to help pay for ramen (or whatever cheap dorm food strikes your fancy). You are now a proud employee of Sell-By Grocers. Welcome to the team!
Well… I say “team,” but in reality, it’s just you — and your manager, Biff. Stay safe out there.

Shift Happens is a fully first-person experience where you order stock, fill shelves, process customers, and keep the store running — no matter what’s being sold. The job is simple. The systems are efficient. And everything is working exactly as intended. Enjoy your shift.

Multiplayer co-op planned for a future update.
